description: Convert between a dose (mg or mcg), syringe units and mL at a known strength. Give the strength as conc_mg_ml, or as vial_mg + water_ml. Set direction to dose_to_units or units_to_dose. Returns the counterpart plus concentration and mcg per unit. Arithmetic only.

conc_mg_ml.description: Known strength; or give vial_mg + water_ml instead

name: calc_convert
